_rationale: Healthy Taxable account fully funds conversion ordinary tax. Conv tax sourcing rule: conv ordinary tax pulls from Taxable, NOT from extra Trad — rothConversionTaxFromBrokerage > 0 and rothConversionTaxWithheld == 0 confirms it. Total Trad outflow may be slightly above the conversion principal because the engine auto-selects bracket_aware spending (which adds a small Trad pull to soak up the LTCG-cascade withdrawal at 12% federal instead of leaving it on Brokerage at 15% LTCG). That extra Trad pull is SPENDING-side, not conv-tax-side — the conv-tax sourcing invariant still holds.
